artworks.title: Seascape
artworks.medium: pen and ink on tracing paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.2 x 13.2 cm (7 9/16 x 5 3/16 in.)
support: 21.1 x 15.1 cm (8 5/16 x 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a pen and ink drawing of a bustling seaside scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not distinctly visible, being blocked by an impressive architectural landscape and a grand ship with masts nearly reaching the top of the frame. The drawing features intricate fine, linear brushstrokes and cross-hatching for detail and texture. The color palette is deep black ink on beige paper, emphasizing the lines and shading. Closest to us, a group of people are on boats near rocky steps leading to a grand structure topped with a statue. Elaborate buildings with pointed roofs and intricate facades fill the scene, with swirling clouds sketched in the sky.

artworks.title: The Bathers (Small Plate)
artworks.description: This is a painting of nude figures in a natural landscape. The scene depicts several figures in various poses, some standing and some sitting or crouching, set against a backdrop of trees and greenery. The figures are outlined with bold lines, and the use of color is soft, with earthy tones that emphasize the natural setting. The style of the painting is characterized by its simplified forms and emphasis on the overall harmony of the composition. This is in the style of Paul Cézanne, featuring similar themes and techniques commonly found in his work.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to the side with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee, with his eyes looking forward. He is wearing a flat cap, a suit jacket, a shirt, and a bow tie. His left arm is slightly raised. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Seriez vous sensible?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with figures looking at artwork. The image depicts a group of figures standing in front of a wall displayed with art. The figures are engaged with the artworks hung on the wall. The setting is a cobblestone street with a building facade as a backdrop. The figures' clothing suggests a historical period setting, with elements like a tall hat with a plume and a dress with lace. The street scene captures a moment of public engagement with art in a communal space.

artworks.title: Ah! très bien j'en suis sur! malheureuse...
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing on a small step with one knee bent and the other leg extended. He appears to be looking into a window of a coach or carriage marked with the number "13." The man has exaggerated facial features, with a large nose and a surprised expression. His hair is windswept, suggesting movement. He is wearing a formal coat with long tails and a tall, cylindrical hat, holding onto the carriage for balance. The background is a simple sketch with no extra details, emphasizing the man's interaction with the carriage.

artworks.title: Ah vous trouvez que mon dernier roman n'est pas tout a fait...
artworks.description: The image shows two women in full length. The woman on the left is bending forward, holding her dress with one hand, looking upwards, with short curly hair and wearing a long striped dress. The woman on the right is leaning against a tall piece of furniture with closed eyes, neutral expression, short curly hair, and wearing a long-sleeved dark dress and a choker necklace. The room is simple with an empty frame on the wall.

artworks.title: L'Avocat que se trouve mal
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene with people, some of whom wear dark robes and hats. The central figure appears dramatic while others in the room are focused on an intense exchange or observation. The setting includes a raised platform where two individuals stand overseeing the proceedings. The use of shading and line work emphasizes the folds of clothing and expressions, highlighting the dynamic and somewhat humorous nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Carotte de l'écrin
artworks.description: The image features a seated woman and a standing man. The woman is reclining in a chair with her arms on her lap and her head turned upwards. She has short hair and wears a long dress. The man is standing in front of her, leaning slightly forward with his hands in his pockets. He wears a dark coat over a white shirt and a dark vest, with short, curly hair and distinct facial features. The setting includes a curtain, an upholstered chair, a framed artwork on the wall, and a carpet on the floor.

artworks.title: Carotte du voltigeur
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing facing each other. The man on the left is in a slight crouch with his head tilted forward, wearing a loose-fitting costume reminiscent of a clown or jester, including a hat with a floppy brim and trousers that billow at the waist and cuffs. His facial features are prominent with a defined nose, and he has a concentrated expression. The man on the right stands upright with his arms akimbo, wearing a formal suit with tails and a tall top hat. His face is serious, with a stern look, and he is clean-shaven. In the background, there is a crowd of indistinct figures on the left side, while the right side shows a plain, light-toned wall.

artworks.title: C'est bien parce que c'est votre ami...
artworks.description: The image shows three men in an interior setting. In the center, a man is leaning over a desk. The man on the left stands slightly behind the desk, while the man on the right stands facing the central figure. The background includes a decorated wall, a door, and a framed picture above the desk. The floor has an ornate carpet.

artworks.title: C'est singulier... il ne me vient plus d'idées... que...
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing. On the right, a woman stands in a side profile position, facing away from the viewer, holding a walking stick in her right hand. She wears a dark gown with a full skirt, a hat with a veil, and an updo. On the left, a man stands with his hands in his pockets. He has a prominent forehead, defined nose, and short, disheveled hair. He wears a dark jacket over a lighter waistcoat and light checkered trousers. The background shows a large framed picture or painting of a person riding a horse.

artworks.title: Le Charivari reconnaissant a l'année 1841
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure kneeling on the ground surrounded by laurel wreaths. The figure appears to be arranging the wreaths which are scattered around. The wings are large and detailed, contrasting with the figure's upper body. The background has a gradient from light to dark. The composition emphasizes the figure's posture and the laurel wreaths' symbolic meaning.

artworks.title: Le Constitutionnel et le Juif errant
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. The figure on the left is slightly hunched, wearing a long coat, a vest, and trousers, leaning on a cane. They wear a pointed hat labeled "CONG." The figure on the right is standing upright, holding a crooked stick with a hand outstretched. They have a long, bushy beard and are wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat with a sash tied around the waist, knee-high socks, and shoes. A small bag is tied to their waist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Un Début a la chasse
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of two men, revealing their upper bodies. The man on the left is slightly hunched over, with his left hand raised. He has medium-length, wavy hair and wears a dark jacket over a checkered shirt or apron. The other man stands upright, with a surprised or perplexed expression. He has short hair, wears a large, dark top hat, a dark jacket over a light-colored vest, and holds a slender stick or cane. Both men are standing against a plain background with illegible handwritten words at the top right of the image.

artworks.title: Emportez donc ça plus loin... impossible de travailler...
Entrez Messieurs... voici de magnifiques...
artworks.description: This print shows three people wearing long coats and hats and approaching a tall curtain with the sign "VENTE A 50% DE RABAIS." The two people on the left wear dark coats and look to the right with unhappy expressions. The person at the center is facing away from us and grabbing one of the men's arms, gesturing into the curtain on the right with their other hand. They wear a lighter coat with a checkered pattern and a flat round cap instead of the top hats the other two men are wearing. All three people have light skin. Another person is visible in the background on the left, and nothing is visible on the right behind the curtain.

artworks.title: L'Ex-Colonel
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures in a room. On the left, a man stands with folded arms, wearing a top hat, long military coat, and a sword at his hip. He stands confidently with one leg forward. On the right, another man stands upright, gesturing as if in conversation. He wears a vest over a collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves. In the background, there is a suggestion of a mirror reflecting two individuals in top hats. The room is sparse with a plain wall, a hat on a hook, and handwritten notes and artist signatures on the perimeter.

artworks.title: Une Femme comme moi... remettre un bouton?...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and an object above them. The man on the left is standing upright with his hands in front of him, clasped together. He has distinct bushy eyebrows and sideburns, and his hair is slightly unkempt. He wears a loosely fitted shirt, tight pants, and slipper-like shoes. Above his head is an unusual object that appears to be a humanoid figure in a playful or unusual pose. The woman on the right is seated or crouched, slightly turned towards the man, with an oval face and short, neatly combed hair. She wears a long, flowing gown with a fitted bodice and voluminous skirt. Her one hand is raised as if pointing towards the man or the object above. The setting features a simple interior with faintly outlined walls, a large framed painting or mirror in the background, and a patterned floor.

artworks.title: Satané piallard d'enfant va!...
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing indoors. They are holding a skull in one hand and supporting their chin with the other hand, appearing contemplative. The individual has long straight hair, wears glasses, and is dressed in a long robe. They have a serious expression, with a long, narrow face. The scene includes a table with an open book and a lit candle, casting light. In the background, there is a darkened room with a framed portrait on the wall and some objects on a high shelf. The setting is dim and somber with textures and shadows.

artworks.title: Un Grand homme de plus
artworks.description: The image depicts two people, a man and a woman, engaged in conversation. The man, standing on the right, holds a document labeled "Brevet d'invention," a coiled rope, and a candle holder. The woman, on the left, is seen with her back slightly turned towards the viewer, wearing a patterned dress. The background is sketchy and textured.

artworks.title: Une Heureuse nouvelle
artworks.description: This image shows two men from the waist up, engaged in conversation. The man on the left has a prominent nose, a slightly bulging forehead, and a receding hairline with curly hair at the back. His facial expression appears inquisitive with a hint of a smile. He is wearing a dark coat over a white shirt. The man on the right has a serious expression, with defined features, more delicate lines on his face, and a fuller head of hair swept back. He is dressed in a dark jacket over a dark shirt, with a white cloth folded and hanging over one arm. The setting is simple with no detailed background, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Ce Journal trouve mon ouvrage pitoyable...
artworks.description: The image shows two women in a room. The woman in the foreground is standing facing forward with her eyebrows raised and her hair styled in two loose buns. She is holding a sheet of paper or fabric titled "Dr. BROW." Another woman in the background is partially turned away, holding a tray in her left hand. The room has a framed portrait on the wall, a curtain, a rococo-style table, and minimal furnishings.

artworks.title: Laissez dire un peu de mal de vous...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene with various individuals depicted. They are engaged in different activities such as whispering and having conversations. The scene suggests a legal environment, possibly a courtroom, based on the attire and setting. The drawing is in black and white, emphasizing the interactions among the figures. The details in shading and line work give depth to the illustration.

artworks.title: Monsieur voila vingt ans que je poursuis l'union de...
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a garden. The man on the left has a round face, a prominent nose, and wears a brimless hat with a tassel. He is wearing a vertically striped coat and checkered trousers, with his hands clasped in front holding a rounded object. The man on the right wears a tall top hat, a dark jacket, a light shirt, and white trousers. One hand is in his pocket. The background features a trellis fence, leafy foliage, and lines suggesting distant trees or hedges. The ground appears lightly shaded.
